snippet.title: Rustown - Official Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Check out gameplay and learn more about the world of Rustown in this trailer for the upcoming story-driven action-adventure game from developer Plotrick. Rustown is set in a slum inhabited by infected outcasts suffering from cognitive decline. Receiving a letter from her missing father after three years of silence, can she find him in this lawless zone? 'Rustown': A tender dystopia dedicated to those weary of hatred. Rustown will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and Cloud on June 30, 2027.

In this story-driven stealth adventure, players explore Rustown, avoid danger without fighting, and uncover clues while getting to know its residents. Jian’s search reveals conflict and prejudice, but also people who care for one another.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
